properties.name: IsCrushable
properties.comment: Is this object squashable by heavy vehicles? If it is, then the vehicle can travel over this object and destroy it in the process.

properties.name: IsStealthy
properties.comment: Does this object type NOT show up on radar scans? If true, then in any radar display, only the underlying ground will be show, not this object. Most terrain falls into this category, but only a few special real units/buildings do.

properties.name: IsSelectable
properties.comment: It is legal to "select" some objects in the game. If it is legal to select this object type then this flag will be true. Selected game objects typically display a floating health bar and allows special user I/O control.

properties.name: IsLegalTarget
properties.comment: Can this object be the target of an attack or move command? Typically, only objects that take damage or can be destroyed are allowed to be a target.

properties.name: IsInsignificant
properties.comment: "Insignificant" objects will not be announced when they are destroyed or when they appear. Terrain elements and some lesser vehicles have this characteristic.

properties.name: IsImmune
properties.comment: Is this object immune to normal combat damage? Rocks and other inert type terrain object are typically of this type.

properties.name: IsFlammable
properties.comment: If this terrain object is flammable (such as trees are) then this flag will be true. Flammable objects can catch fire if damaged by flame type weapons.

properties.name: IsSentient
properties.comment: "Sentient" objects are ones that have logic AI processing performed on them. All vehicles, buildings, infantry, and aircraft are so flagged. Terrain elements also fall under this category, but only because certain animation effects require this.

properties.name: Armor
properties.comment: The defense of this object is greatly affected by the type of armor it possesses. This value specifies the type of armor.

properties.name: MaxStrength
properties.comment: This is the maximum strength of this object type.
